rejected_rule.statement: A prospective purchaser who is permitted, pending his purchase, to occupy the premises on payment of an agreed consideration may not be considered a tenant during that period.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote:
"While the defendant occupied under (even a valid) contract for the sale of the property to him, he could not be considered as a tenant."
Lord Abinger C.B. in Howard v. Shaw [8M.&W. 118 (=151 E.R. 973)].
